meta.name: arboreto
meta.description: Infer gene regulatory networks (GRNs) from gene expression data using scalable algorithms (GRNBoost2, GENIE3). Use when analyzing transcriptomics data (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq) to identify transcription factor-target gene relationships and regulatory interactions. Supports distributed computation for large-scale datasets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 识别转录因子与靶基因的调控关系
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有转录组数据,想找到基因间的调控网络
copy.tagline_en: Identify regulatory relationships between transcription factors and target genes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have transcriptomics data and want to uncover gene regulatory networks

howto.what: Claude 会用 arboreto 的 GRNBoost2 或 GENIE3 算法,从基因表达数据推断转录因子与靶基因之间的调控关系,产出含 TF、target、importance 三列的表格文件。
howto.when: 当你分析转录组数据(bulk RNA-seq、单细胞 RNA-seq 等),要找出转录因子与靶基因的调控关系时,它会接管。

say.text: 用 human_tfs.txt 里的转录因子过滤,只推断这些 TF 的靶基因
say.note: 限制推断范围到指定转录因子

howto.what_en: Claude uses arboreto's GRNBoost2 or GENIE3 algorithms to infer transcription factor-target gene regulatory links from expression data, producing a table with TF, target, and importance columns.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you analyze transcriptomics data (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq, etc.) and want to find transcription factor-target gene regulatory relationships.

say_en.text: Run GRNBoost2 on expression_data.tsv and save the network to network.tsv
Keep links with importance above 0.5 and set the seed to 42
Restrict inference to the TFs in human_tfs.txt
say_en.note: Limits inference to given transcription factors
